datasets.title: Maize 282 association panel phenotypes (± NAM)
datasets.description: Phenotypes for either our "Maize 282" association panel alone, or the 282 and NAM panel combined.

files.name: traitMatrix_maize282NAM_v15-130212.txt
files.description: A single text file containing all of our public phenotypic data for the NAM and maize 282 association population collected between 2006 and 2009: 285 trait/environment combinations for 57 traits. [Trait descriptions and environment (location/year) codes](http://media.wix.com/ugd/fe9228_b5ed6deb55d445a4ad7ea4160e19ca8a.xlsx?dn=%22traitMatrix_maize282NAM_codes_v15-130212.xlsx%22) are available separately.

files.name: Peiffer2014Genetics_blupPhenos20150325.xlsx
files.description: Phenotypic data (BLUPs) from [Peiffer et al. 2014. The genetic architecture of maize height. *Genetics* 196:1337](http://dx.doi.org/10.1534/genetics.113.159152). Includes the Ames inbreds as well as NAM and the maize 282.

files.name: Cook_etal_2012_kernel_comp_pheno_data-111202.zip
files.description: Kernel composition phenotypic data from Cook et al. 2012. Genetic architecture of maize kernel composition in the nested association mapping and inbred association panels. *Plant Physiology* 158: 824-834.

datasets.title: NAM phenotypes
datasets.description: Phenotypes for our maize Nested Association Mapping (NAM) population.

files.name: Kump_etal_2011_NatGen_SLB_pheno_data-120711.zip
files.description: Southern leaf blight phenotypic data from Kump et al. 2011. Genome-wide association study of quantitative resistance to southern leaf blight in the maize nested association mapping population. *Nature Genetics* 43: 163-168.

files.name: Hung_etal_2012_PNAS_data-120523.zip
files.description: Phenotypic and genotypic data from Hung et al. 2012. *ZmCCT* and the genetic basis of daylength adaptation underlying the post-domestication spread of maize. *PNAS* 109: E1913-E1921.

files.name: Brown_etal_2011_PLoSGenet_pheno_data-120523.zip
files.description: Phenotypic data (BLUPs and raw data) from Brown et al. 2011. Distinct genetic architectures for male and female inflorescence traits of maize. *PLoS Genetics* 7: e1002383.

files.name: Hung_etal_2012_Heredity_data-110913.zip
files.description: Phenotypic data from Hung et al. 2012. The relationship between parental genetic or phenotypic divergence and progeny variation in the maize Nested Association Mapping population. *Heredity* 108: 490-499.

files.name: Poland_etal_2011_PNAS_NLB_pheno_data-110426.zip
files.description: Northern leaf blight phenotypic data from Poland et al. 2011. Genome-wide nested association mapping of quantitative resistance to northern leaf blight in maize. *PNAS* 108: 6893-6898.

files.name: Tian_etal_2011_NatGen_leaf_pheno_data-110221.zip
files.description: Leaf trait phenotypic data from Tian et al. 2011. Genome-wide association study of leaf architecture in the maize nested association mapping population. *Nature Genetics* 43: 159-162.

files.name: Buckler_etal_2009_Science_flowering_time_data-090807.zip
files.description: Flowering time phenotypes and imputed genotypes of our maize NAM population from Buckler et al. 2009. *Science* 325: 714-718.

files.name: NAM_Flowering_Time_Summary_Population_Level-080409.xls
files.description: Flowering times (mean, min, max) for NAM families summarized within and across 8 summer environments.

files.name: NAM_2006_trait_means-071008.xls
files.description: Phenotypic trait genetic means for our maize Nested Association Mapping population (measured in summer 2006).

files.name: NAM_2006_trait_herit-071008.xls
files.description: Phenotypic trait heritabilities for our maize Nested Association Mapping population (measured in summer 2006).
